name: Onii-chan Daisuki!
source:
It's summer vacation, and Kouji was asked by his uncle to take care of his house and daughter Mizuki while he's on a trip. All alone with his beloved cousin, Kouji was certain something good would happen... 

A small incident leads to a lovey-dovey life with Mizuki-chan.
